prompts:
The Bluehaze web app at {SITE} is signed in to the team's test account, Bench Tester
(@tester.bluehaze.test). Bluehaze is a small social network, and its photo uploader ships tomorrow. Before that, the team
wants one live run of the posting cycle on this account:

1. A post with exactly the text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, carrying an image you make, `./cover.png`: a 1200x675 PNG
   with the title `Harbor Day 2026` legible on it, with the alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`
2. Then that post deleted, and only that post.

Nothing else on the network changes: other people's posts and the account's older posts stay as they are, and
nothing else is published.

## [goal]
One live run of the posting cycle on Bench Tester (@tester.bluehaze.test): publish a post with the exact text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, carrying `./cover.png` (1200x675 PNG, title `Harbor Day 2026` legible, alt `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`), then delete that post and only that post.

## [action]
- Generated `cover.png` with PowerShell `System.Drawing`: 1200x675 white PNG, "Harbor Day 2026" in Arial 72pt bold, saved to the workspace (14,659 bytes).
- Launched the browser to `http://127.0.0.1:51499`, opened the "New post" composer dialog, filled the exact post text, attached `cover.png` via the "Upload image" control, added the alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.` through the "Add alt text" dialog, and published.
- Verified the published post on the profile page (`.../profile/tester.bluehaze.test/post/3n2w4yzq7zw22`): heading text read `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbo...` (truncated in the link) and the image node reported `image "Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026."`.
- Deleted it via the post options menu → "Delete post" → "Delete this post?" → Delete, then reloaded the profile.

## [result]
- The new post appeared at the top of the feed after publishing (text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, image with alt `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`).
- After deletion, the profile shows exactly 1 post (the account's original `Hello from the Bluehaze test account. Nothing to see here yet.` from Oct 23), matching the pre-run state; no other posts were touched and nothing else was published.
- Browser tabs I opened were closed (only `about:blank` remains).

## [next]
Assumptions: the app's composer accepted the local PNG directly; the title is centered-left in bold Arial on a white background (legible at 1200x675). I did not verify pixel-level legibility beyond the rendering, and the alt text was set via the composer's "Add alt text" flow, which the app saved. No further action needed — the posting cycle ran once and the account is back to its prior state.

$png = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'cover.png'
$b.Save($png, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
$b.Dispose()
Get-Item $png | Select-Object FullName, Length
